title: PAR-40 / 7G.2 VPORT to SUN owner-edge replay
mode: local generated DXF implementation and focused validation
scope: Exercise a VPORT hard-owner SUN graph through ASCII and binary DXF replay
Verify that raw SUN owner code 330 follows a reminted VPORT table-record identity
Preserve fail-closed behavior for inconsistent typed/raw owner identity
Keep VIEWPORT positive qualification, VIEW code 361, Skylight code 340, DWG parsing, and rendering semantics separate

implementation.behavior: Added an owner-aware overload for raw OBJECTS replay while retaining the original one-argument API entry point. The opt-in path requires a SUN carrier registered by the adapter's resolved-SUN set, an already emitted table/entity owner identity, and exactly one code-330 group matching both the typed parent handle and explicit source owner; it writes the owner using the source-to-output mapping. VPORT handle allocation and group-361 remapping use the same output identity. Both owner-aware calls without the registered graph and the legacy one-argument raw SUN call remain fail-closed; the original one-argument API remains available for non-SUN raw objects.
generatedControls: Generated AC1027 ASCII and binary DXF import one VPORT handle 0x721 whose group 361 references SUN 0x706, with raw SUN code 330 owning the VPORT.
Re-export and re-import assert the VPORT handle is reminted and the typed VPORT target, typed SUN owner, and raw SUN owner all converge on their emitted identities.
Changing the typed/raw owner identity without changing the VPORT reference rejects export while preserving a pre-existing destination sentinel.
A direct raw-object owner-override attempt without a resolved SUN graph and emitted owner mapping rejects without replacing a pre-existing destination.
The legacy one-argument raw SUN writer rejects without replacing a pre-existing destination.

focusedResults: VPORT/SUN owner-graph replay, handle remapping, and both direct writer bypass refusals: PASS
Background/SUN typed and raw callback retention: PASS

assessment.closedScope: Generated VPORT-owned SUN structural round-trip and remapped raw owner identity pass for ASCII and binary AC1027 controls; mismatched typed/raw owner identity fails atomically.
assessment.remaining: Add an independent positive generated VIEWPORT-owned SUN control before claiming that owner route is exercised. No native producer, rendering, sun/shadow semantics, DWG SUN path, VIEW group 361, or Skylight-to-SUN qualification is established.
